briefTitle: A Clinical Trial to Test if an Investigational Combination Therapy With BNT326 and BNT327 is Safe and Potentially Beneficial for People With Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

typedChecks.sourceText: Aged ≥18 years at the time of giving informed consent. Local laws will be followed if the age of consent is older.

typedChecks.sourceText: Have Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 or 1.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have measurable disease defined by RECIST v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.
Prior therapy and biomarker rules differ significantly across multiple study parts and cohorts, making them unsuitable for a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Had disease progression on or were intolerant to prior treatment with an agent targeting HER3 (including antibody, ADC, cell therapy, and other drugs) or with a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload (including topoisomerase I inhibitor-containing ADCs).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy exclusion involves broad classes and exceptions per cohort, which cannot be captured by a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have measurable disease defined by RECIST v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.
Criteria vary extensively across multiple cohorts, including different prior lines and genomic alteration statuses, which cannot be modeled into single typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Had disease progression on or were intolerant to prior treatment with an agent targeting HER3 (including antibody, ADC, cell therapy, and other drugs) or with a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload (including topoisomerase I inhibitor-containing ADCs).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion involves specific drug classes and payload types that do not map to simple typed prior therapy exclusions.
